networks.name: flightrights_desk
networks.description: Calculate EU261, UK261, Turkish SHY-PASSENGER, and US DOT flight compensation, manage Art. 9 care expenses, file confirmed statutory claim dossiers, and verify airport disruptions with Disruption Ledger.
sample_queries: My Lufthansa flight FRA to ZRH was delayed 4.2 hours due to a technical fault. How much EU261 compensation am I owed?
Compare EU261, UK261, and Turkish SHY-PASSENGER for a cancelled Turkish Airlines flight from IST to LHR with 2 days notice.
Add a 48 EUR airport dinner receipt and a 190 EUR hotel receipt to my Art. 9 care ledger.
Ask Disruption Ledger whether FRA had an ATC or weather disruption on 2026-11-24 and which enforcement body covers Germany.
Ask Disruption Ledger to issue a SHA-256 evidence seal for flight LH1186 from FRA to ZRH on 2026-11-24.
Can you file a court lawsuit or rebook my airline ticket directly?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the partner site listed in allowed_peers (Disruption Ledger) after the visitor approves the consent card.
